nodes.description: Public vaultAmount accumulator that funds the bonus pool for burners.
squidStartTime gate after which burning is allowed.
nftStartTime sale opening timestamp.
nftEndTime sale closing timestamp.
Number of players still holding (not burned) NFTs, drives payout math.
Mint counter incremented on every claimApeXNFT.
ERC20 reward token address used for burn payouts.
Total ETH collected from mints.
Whitelist/reserved address mapping.
Number of unclaimed reserved slots.
Flag enabling/disabling whitelist reservation logic.
Packed bitmap of already minted token ids.
Fixed mint price constant (0.001 ether in this build).
NftSquid constructor: sets token/times and pre-mints MAX_PLAYERS to deployer.
onlyOwner function disabling reserved whitelist mode.
onlyOwner batch add of addresses to the reserved whitelist.
onlyOwner batch removal of addresses from the reserved whitelist.
onlyOwner setter for squidStartTime.
onlyOwner setter for nftStartTime.
onlyOwner setter for nftEndTime.
Payable mint: takes price, derives pseudo-random id, mints and marks claimed.
Burns caller's NFT and transfers the ERC20 reward from the contract.
Public view pseudo-random generator seeded by block data and userSeed.
Linear probe loop finding an unclaimed index.
Bitmap lookup checking whether an index was already minted.
Private bitmap writer marking an index as claimed.
onlyOwner function sweeping the full ETH balance to an arbitrary address.
onlyOwner function transferring arbitrary ERC20 balance out.
Internal payout calculator based on time elapsed, remaining owners and vault.
External view wrapper exposing the payout calculation.
msg.sender / _msgSender(): caller controlling mints, burns and role checks.
block.timestamp: used for sale gates, burn gates and randomness.
External IERC20(token).transfer(msg.sender, withdrawAmount) performed at the end of burnAndEarn.
payable(to).transfer(address(this).balance) sending ETH to an owner-chosen address.
External IERC20(token_).transfer(to, amount) in withdrawERC20Token.
Pseudo-random mint id derived from block.timestamp, block.number and blockhash, predictable by miners.
Unchecked-style Counters.increment used for the auto-increment token tracker.
userSeed parameter of claimApeXNFT fed into the randomness generator.
tokenId parameter of burnAndEarn identifying the NFT to burn.
userSeed parameter of random().
index parameter of isClaimed().
address list parameter of addToReserved().
to parameter of withdrawETH, the ETH receiver.
amount parameter of withdrawERC20Token.
rand local in claimApeXNFT holding the resolved unclaimed token id.
_remainOwners cached copy of remainOwners in burnAndEarn.
withdrawAmount local returned by _calWithdrawAmountAndBonus in burnAndEarn.
bonus local returned by _calWithdrawAmountAndBonus in burnAndEarn.
diffTime local computed in _calWithdrawAmountAndBonus.
bonus local computed inside _calWithdrawAmountAndBonus.
randRaw local in claimApeXNFT holding random() output before probing.

edges.reason: userSeed parameter of claimApeXNFT is forwarded to random().
block.timestamp seeds the random() hash making the mint id timestamp dependent.
random() output is derived from block.timestamp/block.number/blockhash (weak randomness).
random() return value is stored in randRaw.
randRaw is passed into getUnusedRandom for collision probing.
getUnusedRandom returns the unclaimed index stored in rand.
getUnusedRandom loops calling isClaimed to find a free slot.
rand index is marked as claimed via _setClaimed.
rand is used as tokenId for _mint inside claimApeXNFT.
msg.sender is the payer and recipient of the minted NFT.
block.timestamp is compared against nftStartTime/nftEndTime in claimApeXNFT.
price constant validates msg.value == price.
totalEth is incremented by price on each claim.
remainOwners is incremented and bounded by MAX_PLAYERS.
id counter is incremented on each claim.
reservedOn flag selects the whitelist-aware sale cap.
reserved mapping is checked and cleared for whitelisted senders.
reservedCount is decremented when a reserved address claims.
tokenId parameter selects the NFT to burn in burnAndEarn.
ownerOf(tokenId) == msg.sender authority check in burnAndEarn.
block.timestamp >= squidStartTime gates the burn.
squidStartTime state is used to gate burnAndEarn.
remainOwners is cached into the _remainOwners local.
cached _remainOwners is decremented and written back to remainOwners.
burnAndEarn calls _calWithdrawAmountAndBonus to compute the payout.
withdrawAmount returned by _calWithdrawAmountAndBonus into burnAndEarn.
bonus returned by _calWithdrawAmountAndBonus into burnAndEarn.
vaultAmount is adjusted by BONUS_PERPAX - bonus in burnAndEarn.
withdrawAmount is the value passed to the ERC20 transfer.
msg.sender is the recipient of the ERC20 payout.
token address is used as the target of the ERC20 transfer call.
burnAndEarn performs an external ERC20 transfer to msg.sender after state updates, a reentrancy surface.
index parameter is used to compute the bitmap word and bit in isClaimed.
claimedBitMap storage is read in isClaimed.
claimedBitMap storage is written in _setClaimed.
address list parameter is iterated in addToReserved.
block.timestamp < nftEndTime is required to add reserved addresses.
reserved mapping is written for new whitelisted addresses.
reservedCount is incremented in addToReserved.
address list parameter is iterated in removeFromReserved.
block.timestamp < nftEndTime gates removeFromReserved.
reserved mapping entries are deleted in removeFromReserved.
reservedCount is decremented in removeFromReserved.
to parameter is the ETH recipient in withdrawETH.
withdrawETH performs an external ETH transfer to an owner-chosen address.
amount parameter is the ERC20 quantity transferred in withdrawERC20Token.
withdrawERC20Token performs an external ERC20 transfer to an arbitrary address.
calWithdrawAmountAndBonus view wrapper calls _calWithdrawAmountAndBonus.
vaultAmount is used in the bonus computation and last-player branch.
squidStartTime + HALF_YEAR defines endTime in the payout formula.
block.timestamp determines diffTime in the reward calculation.
remainOwners drives the per-owner vault share and the last-owner branch.
diffTime is produced inside _calWithdrawAmountAndBonus.
diffTime feeds the bonus multiplication/division arithmetic in the payout formula.
bonus local results from the payout arithmetic in _calWithdrawAmountAndBonus.
bonus is capped at vaultAmount + BONUS_PERPAX before withdrawAmount is derived.
onlyOwner setReservedOff flips the reservedOn flag.
onlyOwner setSquidStartTime writes squidStartTime.
onlyOwner setNFTStartTime writes nftStartTime.
onlyOwner setNFTEndTime writes nftEndTime.
block.timestamp is compared against the new start time in setNFTStartTime.
nftStartTime is compared with the new end time in setNFTEndTime.
nftEndTime is compared with the new squid start time in setSquidStartTime.
constructor stores the reward token address in token.
constructor initializes nftStartTime.
constructor initializes nftEndTime.
deployer msg.sender receives admin/minter/pauser roles and the pre-minted supply.
Counters increment used by the preset minter path invoked during the sale lifecycle.
reservedOn set by setReservedOff changes the sale cap branch in claimApeXNFT.
reserved whitelist filled by addToReserved affects claimApeXNFT cap accounting.
squidStartTime configured by setSquidStartTime gates burnAndEarn.

normalization_plan.reason: userSeed is a parameter of claimApeXNFT and should be merged into the claimApeXNFT core function.
tokenId is a parameter of burnAndEarn and should be merged into the burnAndEarn core function.
userSeed is a parameter of the random core function and should be merged into it.
index is a parameter of the isClaimed core function and should be merged into it.
list is a parameter of addToReserved and should be merged into that core function.
to is a parameter of withdrawETH and should be merged into that core function.
amount is a parameter of withdrawERC20Token and should be merged into that core function.
rand is a local variable of claimApeXNFT and should be merged into the claimApeXNFT core function.
_remainOwners is a local cache inside burnAndEarn and should be merged into that core function.
withdrawAmount is the local value flowing directly into the unsafe ERC20 transfer, so it should be merged into that unsafe operation.
bonus is a local of burnAndEarn used to adjust vaultAmount and should be merged into the burnAndEarn core function.
diffTime is a local of the payout calculator and should be merged into _calWithdrawAmountAndBonus.
bonus is a local of the payout calculator and should be merged into _calWithdrawAmountAndBonus.
randRaw holds the random() output before probing and should be merged into the random core function.
